nights.title: The Clause
nights.name: The Clause
nights.extract: The Clause are a British alternative rock band from Birmingham, England, formed in the 2010s. The group consists of Pearce “Macca”, Liam Deakin (guitar), Jonny Fyffe (bass), and Niall Fennell (drums). Their music blends elements of indie rock, funk, rhythm and blues, drawing influences from 1960s swagger, 1980s groove, and 1990s attitude. The band released their debut studio album, Victim of a Casual Thing, in October 2025.

nights.title: Blossoms
nights.name: Blossoms
nights.extract: Blossoms are an English indie rock band from Stockport, Greater Manchester, England. Formed in 2013, the band consists of Tom Ogden, Charlie Salt, Josh Dewhurst, Joe Donovan (drums) and Myles Kellock.

nights.title: Dayseeker
nights.name: Dayseeker
nights.extract: Dayseeker is an American post-hardcore band formed in Orange County, California, in 2012. The group consists of vocalist Rory Rodriguez, bassist Ramone Valerio and drummer Zac Mayfield. They are currently signed to Spinefarm Records and have released six studio albums. Their most recent studio album, Creature in the Black Night, was released on October 24, 2025 with a Redux deluxe edition scheduled to release on February 26, 2027.
